es.es: Dos billetes para Segovia, por favor.
es.english: Two tickets to Segovia, please.
One-way or round-trip?
One-way.
What time does the train leave?
At eleven fifteen

es.es: Tienes suerte, es el tren directo.
es.english: You're lucky, it's the direct train.
Do we have time for a coffee?
Yes, we have half an hour.

es.es: ¿En qué andén sale el tren para Segovia?
es.english: Which platform does the train to Segovia leave from?
es.ipa: [en ke anˈden ˈsale el tɾen paɾa seˈɣoβja]

es.es: El andén número siete. Verás los carteles.
es.english: Platform number seven. You will see the signs.
es.ipa: [el anˈden ˈnumeɾo ˈsjete βeˈɾas los kaɾˈteles]

es.english: Don't forget your bag!

es.es: Ya la he cogido. ¿Y tú, tienes los billetes?
es.english: I've already taken it. And you, do you have the tickets?
es.ipa: [ʝa la e koˈxiðo i ˈtu ˈtjenes los βiˈʎetes]

es.english: Yes, in my pocket.
Are you ready for the adventure?
Yes, more than ever!
The train will arrive soon.

es.es: Subamos rápido, que hay mucha gente.
es.english: Let's get on quickly, there are a lot of people.

es.es: Aquí están nuestros asientos. ¡Junto a la ventana!
es.english: Here are our seats. Next to the window!
es.ipa: [aˈki esˈtan nwestɾos aˈsjentos ˈxunto a la βenˈtana]

es.english: We start a new life!

es.es: Una semana después, Sophie y Lucas están frente a la Estación de Atocha.
es.english: A week later, Sophie and Lucas stand in front of the Atocha Station.
es.ipa: [ˈuna seˈmana desˈpwes ˈsofi i ˈlukas esˈtan ˈfɾente a la estaˈθjon de aˈtotʃa]

es.english: Their backpacks are ready.

es.es: La emoción se mezcla con la nerviosidad.
es.english: Excitement mixes with nervousness.
es.ipa: [la emoˈθjon se ˈmeθkla kon la nerβjoˈsiðað]

es.english: They approach the counter.
Lucas looks at his watch.

es.es: Encuentran un café en la estación.
es.english: They find a café in the station.
Sophie takes a deep breath.

es.es: Una anunciación resuena en la estación.
es.english: An announcement echoes in the station.

es.es: Encuentran sus asientos en el vagón.
es.english: They find their seats in the carriage.

es.es: Sophie mira cómo Madrid se aleja.
es.english: Sophie watches as Madrid fades away.
